_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0-of-72 recent windows showing ±2+ point movement and no visible breaker in the divergent factor set, HOLD is the statistically honest call—this coil persists until ETF flows or VIX resolve directionally.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst says HOLD with medium conviction citing coil persistence; narrative implies UP toward recovery but provides no explicit forward direction, creating a silent split on next-move direction.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows turn positive AND funding cools below 0.003% with BTC holding 62K — shifts toward Denial/Disbelief recovery leg
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX breaks above 20 AND BTC loses 60K with funding spiking above 0.01% — deepens Panic toward Capitulation
